W.note: A tidy 32px pill collapses to a 316px-wide, roughly 440px-tall package list that opens and closes instantly with no transition, and it tracks status, ETA, carrier and last four digits but has no per-step timeline and its Next step buttons are not labelled with the package name.

X.note: A compact top-right pill opens to a clean five-step timeline with dates, expected windows, carrier and tracking number, animated with a grid-rows transition, labelled controls, Escape returning focus, and reduced-motion handling, though it shows only one parcel and has no in-panel actions outside an exception.

Y.note: The toast opens smoothly to a five-step timeline with expected tags, exception actions, history and Dismiss, auto-collapses to a restorable pill, and keeps a polite live region and Escape-to-focus-return, making it the most complete and robust of the four.

Z.note: The teal-on-dark multi-package panel with filters and a per-package track is the most feature-rich, but it is the largest when open, uses a tiny text chevron and no open transition, and re-renders the whole toast on every click so keyboard focus is lost after each interaction.
